nodes.long_description:
1. adjust the volume of the environment.
2. press the Boyle button, the temperature will be fixed and the air pressure will also go down as the volume becomes smaller. As the volume increases, the air pressure increases.
3. press the Charles button and the air pressure will be fixed and the temperature will increase with the volume and decrease with the volume.

<Result
- A constant volume of gas at constant pressure will increase in volume at a constant rate as the temperature increases, regardless of the type of gas.
nodes.short_description: Experience how temperature and pressure affect the volume of a gas. This experiment demonstrates the gas laws, showing the dynamic relationship between these fundamental properties
